messages:
Maria G: heads-up — onboarding EU healthcare customer in northeurope, need vnet/subnet + NAT design for GPU cluster. target: 3 AZs, ~6 A100 instances, heavy model pull traffic initially. Can we get guidance on public IP / SNAT port sizing and any AZ affinity to avoid cross-AZ egress charges?
Jake L: can you paste the subscription id and rough start date? also which GPU SKU exactly (A100 v4 or A10)?
Maria G: sub: xxxxx-azure-7890, start: in 2 weeks. Prefer A100 (a few nodes) + fallback on T4 for burst. Rough numbers: 6 primary GPUs, 3 spare.
CloudOps Bot: FYI — Azure standard NAT Gateway supports up to 16 public IPs per gateway. SNAT port count per public IP ~ 64k. For large ephemeral connections consider multiple public IPs + multiple NAT gateways. https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network/nat-gateway
Kai N: TL;DR: we'll want 2 NAT Gateways (one per AZ pair) + 4 static public IPs to start. Why: A100 VMs open a lot of outbound connections during model pulls and training container pulls, and SNAT exhaustion is real. Plan: one NAT GW per worker subnet zone, Standard SKU, and set multiple public IPs attached.
Oliver S: Also watch regional GPU quota — Azure often has per-region limits for A100. I'll open a quota increase for A100 family and for vCPU if you need VMSS scale.
Ashley P: For the network bits: propose VNet CIDR 10.40.0.0/20 to allow multiple subnets: controlplane /26, workers /22 (split per AZ), infra /24. Example:
```
10.40.0.0/26  - control
10.40.1.0/24  - infra (jumpboxes, monitoring)
10.40.2.0/22  - workers-AZ1 (VMSS)
10.40.6.0/22  - workers-AZ2
10.40.10.0/22 - workers-AZ3
```
Maria G: perfect. any concerns with PrivateLink (ACR, KeyVault) + NAT? we need to pull images privately where possible.
Kai N: Private Endpoints are fine — they live in a subnet and traffic to PaaS goes over MS backbone. Outbound to the public internet (package registries, telemetry) still uses NAT. If you want to avoid any egress to internet, you need service endpoints/proxy or set deny rules.
Jake L: I'll file the support ticket. Asking for: A100 quota + vCPU bump, 8 static Public IPs in northeurope, raise SNAT ports to effectively 8 * 64k, and increase regional public IP quota if needed. Any exact numbers you want in the ticket?
Maria G: Put counts: A100: 9 (6 prod + 3 spare), vCPU: +204, Public IPs: 8, NAT Gateways: allow 2 (we'll attach 4 IPs each, but request API support for 8 IPs), and ask for priority support for PrivateLink names.
Infra-Bot: note from previous deploy: 1852007200 — observed SYN_TIMEOUTs during image pulls, SNAT usage peaked at ~240k ports across a single IP, causing connection failures.
Oliver S: I'm drafting the Azure quota request now. Will include both GPU family and Networking quotas. Expect ticket id: AZ-2026-8573.
Jake L: routing plan: use per-subnet route table to force 0.0.0.0/0 via NAT gateway. Add UDRs for onprem peering traffic to go to appliance.
Ashley P: Also recommend enabling accelerated networking on worker VMs to reduce latency. And make sure VMSS upgrade policy is set to 'manual' for controlled rollouts.
Maria G: thanks all — do we need to pre-provision the public IPs before we create VMSS?
Kai N: Yes, pre-create static Standard Public IPs and attach to NAT. Also tag them for tracking (owner=infra, project=eu-health).
Jake L: filing ticket now. I'll post the support link and ticket id here when created.
Maria G: :thumbsup: any blockers else?
Oliver S: none from quota side. will monitor the approval.
Jake L: ticket created AZ-2026-8573, link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportRequestDetails/resourceId/AZ-2026-8573
Maria G: copied — thanks everyone, will hold off cluster creation until quotas confirmed.
CloudOps Bot: Reminder: once quotas are approved, run a small Canary: 1 node with an image pull loop to validate SNAT behavior before full rollout.
Ashley P: can also add a preflight job in CI that simulates parallel image pulls. I'll add a job to the infra repo.
Maria G: perfect, closing for now.
